how-32-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the slide, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-32-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the slide, then tap three things you notice.

how-32-02-compare.page: Put the visitor with 2 minutes under one tray and the reader with lots of time under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Start reading. Then swap.
how-32-02-compare.say: Put the visitor with two minutes under one tray and the reader with lots of time under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Start reading. Then swap.

how-32-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing exhibit: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-32-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing exhibit: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-32-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap what you see, then name the criterion it fits. Decide if the slide's sentence is strong evidence, and see the answer.
how-32-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap what you see, then name the criterion it fits. Decide if the slide's sentence is strong evidence, and see the answer.

how-32-02-partc.page: Pick your park. Build 6 slides, one for each criterion. Practice with the 2-minute timer. Then make your video (or download your slides) and upload the file to Canvas.
how-32-02-partc.say: Pick your park. Build six slides, one for each criterion. Practice with the two-minute timer. Then make your video, or download your slides, and upload the file to Canvas.
